page.layout: One printed page. Heading "INDEX." at the top, centred. Below it two columns of index entries, left and right, with the left column read first. The left column has entries from D to E, and the right column from E to F, with a closing word "Finni" at the foot.

main_text.head: INDEX.
main_text.l: ProDemetrio Ruffico gerit se Gregorius Strepius | 93

page.notes: The page number is not printed. Two right-hand numbers are doubtful: "Ericus Ruffus" shows "3" with a mark that may be "3[?]" or "31", and "Didacus de Herrera rex" has its number 112 set on a separate line. "Petr. Ferdinandus del Qvier" sets "del" high above the line. "Ferdinandus Berazza" is an abbreviated name with the ending of "Berazza" unclear. The final entry "Finni" has no number printed beside it. Some superscript numbers may be misaligned by the print.
